title: Approved-delta guard matches the latest approval, not the digest-matching one, for older workflow versions
symptom: For a native change whose approvals were recorded by SpecSync workflow_version below 2, Chough's approved-delta guard compares the deltas with the latest definition approval, while SpecSync picks its effective approval by matching the definition digest.
trigger: A change with several definition approvals recorded by an older SpecSync workflow version, where the latest approval is not the one whose definition digest matches the current definition.
expected: The guard compares the deltas with the same approval SpecSync treats as effective.
actual: The guard uses the latest definition approval, as REQ-cli-022 currently words it, so it can refuse or pass against a different approval than SpecSync.
impact: Low: SpecSync 6.1.1 records workflow_version 2 or later, so only changes approved by older SpecSync versions are affected. Found in the PR #23 review; deferred by 0xLeif because fixing it changes REQ-cli-022.

notes.text: status: open -> fix-pending-verification; scope: out-of-scope -> in-scope. Red on 0.5.0: TC-cli-bug-0020-guard-uses-effective-approval failed on leif/0.6.0-0020-red at 4b783df6 (step 1's 0.5.0 code with the test): the guard compared with the latest approval and refused although the effective, digest-matching one matched. Fixed in plan step 12 (PR #238): the guard reads summary.definition_digest and compares with the approval whose digest matches.
status: fix-pending-verification -> verified. Fixed in plan step 12 (PR #238, d507cf28); the case passed after its 0.5.0 failure.
